description: Rank the providers in an agent inventory against the work you need to delegate, and reject the ones that cannot take it, with the price, turnaround, measured reliability and the exact reason for every verdict. Choose this before delegating work to another agent: it turns a list of claiming providers into a ranked, evidenced shortlist and names who must not be engaged. Do not choose this when you already know the provider, for a directory lookup with no requirement to qualify against, or when you need the provider contacted or paid. Example requests: Which of these agent providers can take this CSV cleaning job within 48 hours and under $40? | Qualify this agent inventory against my requirement and tell me who is eligible and why the rest are not. | Rank these subcontractors for the work and show me the evidence behind each verdict.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

providers.description: The customer's providers.json, as text. Supported: JSON: {"providers": [...]} or a bare list, each entry with an identity and capabilities/skills/tools carrying a price and a turnaround. The provider inventory to qualify: A2A agent cards, MCP manifests or registry rows. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

requirement.description: The customer's requirement.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text, one key=value per line: need, budget_usd, deadline_hours, min_success_rate, allow_unknown_price, required_capabilities. The work to delegate and the terms it must meet. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.
